effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Iliad] trait and 1 card with the [TS] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may add your top security card to the hand. Then, if you have 0 security cards, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
